claim: Produces a document/prompt artifact with stated purpose and audience, clear structure, a boundary output contract, and a verification gate for model switches.

baseline.prompt: Write document.md: a short guide for both humans and AI agents explaining how to write a bug report in this repository. Make it clear and useful.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the language artifact elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write document.md: a guide for both humans and AI agents on how to write a bug report in this repository. Follow the artifact rules: state purpose and audience; use structure (headings/lists/code), not a prose wall; define the output contract at the boundary (agents get schema/JSON, not free-form prose for machine consumption); include a verification gate that would apply when the model family changes.
